capabilities: add characters from vault images, image folders, or emoji sprites
tune walking, resting, and idle behaviors with click animations
show quotes and speech bubbles when characters idle or are clicked
generate six feed types (stream, oracle, mail, blog, news, shows) locally with RiScript
run interactive roleplay prompts that make characters respond
disambiguation: Not a tool for managing character sheets or profiles in your notes; it displays animated sprite characters in the workspace.
extras: Desktop-only; feed content is generated locally by bundled RiTa, compromise, and whichx libraries with no AI or network use, and the plugin is GPL-3.0 because RiTa is.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to place ambient, animated sprite characters in the workspace that react to clicks and comment on your typing.
summary: Animated character companion that displays custom sprites in a side panel and walking along the window bottom, with quotes, generated feed content, and roleplay.
